tracks.name: Compass
tracks.blurb: The line behind every live issue since the first day. Each version has to pass a fixed gate on held-out days before it is adopted, and the version that made every hour's forecast is on the record.

tracks.name: Echo
tracks.blurb: A second way of ordering the hours of the day, run beside Compass on the spot series. It keeps Compass's price levels and only re-orders the hours, so any difference is about which hours are cheap, not how cheap.

tracks.name: Scout
tracks.blurb: Built on a different principle from Compass: it reasons about the coming day in words and writes down why, rather than fitting a curve to the past. v0.2 also sees the same issue-time public context we already hold, so scarcity days are harder to miss.

tracks.name: Glance
tracks.blurb: A fast typed read of the coming day: recent history plus the same-issue Compass curve, scored hour by hour with no narrative. Run on every issue beside Compass and scored on the same hours.

experiments.how: Every track forecasts the same delivery day from the same information, after the main issue and before the gate. Scores are on identical hours, against what cleared; a track's error is compared with the main line's on the days that track ran, so the columns are like for like even when the day counts differ.
